name: Merit Loan Scheme for Good Borrowers
benefit: **Loan Limit:** Maximum amount of loan shall be the equal amount paid by the unit. **Interest Concession:** 1% less than the normal rate of interest.
_eligibility_text: The scheme is applicable to the following - - Already assisted units of PIPDIC whose loan accounts are classified as Standard Assets continuously for 3 years. - Good Borrowers who have already settled the loan account with PIPDIC.
